name: Perennial Sentinel
summary: Immortal and unmoving: it holds the line and keeps the Dimensional open, but never truly dies.

face.name: Perennial Sentinel

keyword.name: Stasis
keyword.rules: won't die blocking: stays permanently tapped

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: The Perennial Sentinel cannot attack, and holds the line for the whole game.

face.flavor: It has watched three forests fall. It is still at its post.
